diagnosis.root: The product moved private Buffer state to the ide-buffers value cell under Lisp-2, but the R5 hardware helper still wrote and read the revoked *ide-buffers* symbol.
diagnosis.product_behavior: save-buffer-to correctly reported buffer missing because the product-visible ide-buffers value cell was empty
diagnosis.conclusion: The R4 product is correct; the R5 test helper alone retained the revoked private-state spelling.

structural_fix.harness: Every R5 Buffer helper and reset now uses the ide-buffers value cell.
structural_fix.gate: The Wave-2 policy-name implementation gate rejects any *ide-buffers* occurrence in the hardware UX harness and requires the current value-cell seam.
structural_fix.negative_property: A future stale private-state spelling fails before hardware execution.
structural_fix.required_repin: R5 test closure and static preflight only

gate_effect.passed_receipts: remain valid after offline re-verification against the new harness-only closure
gate_effect.claim: diagnosis only; no ux-complete pass and no product acceptance
